Tera Raid Battle Events

Much like Pokémon Sword & Shield, within the Mystery Gift option is the Poké Portal News. Here, you can download special Tera Raid Battle events that provide Pokémon of a variety of Tera Types or bonuses. This page details all these events, and all Pokémon within



Mighty Kingambit
Release Dates:

Global: August 28th 2026 - September 3rd 2026

The ninety-second Tera Raid Battle event offers a challenge in Black Tera Raid Crystals against a 7 Star Raid Boss. This Raid Boss is Kingambit with the Dark Tera type which comes with the Mightiest Mark for defeating it. It ran in conjunction with Mass Outbreak featuring Pawniard, Bisharp and Kingambit

Release Dates:

The ninety-first Tera Raid Battle event offers a challenge in Black Tera Raid Crystals against a 7 Star Raid Boss. This Raid Boss is Farigiraf with the Fairy Tera type which comes with the Mightiest Mark for defeating it. It ran in conjunction with Mass Outbreaks featuring Girafarig and Farigiraf

Mighty Roaring Moon & Mighty Iron Valiant
Release Dates:

Global: October 3rd 2025 - October 12th 2025

This Raid Boss is Roaring Moon with the Dragon Tera type in Pokémon Scarlet and Iron Valiant with the Fairy Tera Type in Pokémon Violet. Both come with the Mightiest Mark for defeating it.

Alongside this Pokémon Scarlet players will have Great Tusk, Scream Tail, Brute Bonnet, Flutter Mane, Slither Wing, and Sandy Shocks in 5 Star Raids and Pokémon Violet players will have Iron Treads, Iron Bundle, Iron Hands, Iron Jugulis, Iron Moth, and Iron Thorns in 5 Star raids
